data.name: Hinch
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘hēgemon,’ meaning ‘leader’ or ‘ruler,’ Hinch is a name rooted in strength and power. In the Bible, the name is mentioned in the context of the prophet Hosea, who was instructed by God to name his son Lo-Ruhamah, or ‘not loved,’ and his daughter Lo-Ammi, or ‘not my people.’ These names symbolize God’s covenant breaking with Israel, but also His ultimate redemption. The name Hinch, with its meaning of ‘rock’ or ‘stone,’ can be seen as a reminder of God’s steadfastness and faithfulness, even in the midst of trials and hardships.
